title: Build an independent consumer price dataset for India
summary: Help measure how prices changed using independent evidence for India's full 358-item CPI basket. Contribute compute to recover historical prices, match like-for-like goods and services, and document coverage across rural and urban India. The first target is October 2025 to October 2026. An all-India estimate requires a representative matched panel, specialist inputs and independent review.
authority: Independent consumer price research using the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation CPI 2024 classification and expenditure weights
scope: Use the 358-item CPI 2024 basket and all positively weighted state-sector strata.
Build the October 2025 to October 2026 monthly panel from real, dated consumer prices with stable item, market, outlet and specification identifiers.
Track offers, transactions and tariffs separately. Preserve original units, quantities, effective dates, total-price verification and evidence locators.
Record gaps with affected items, periods and missing evidence. Publish a national estimate only after a representative panel and its calculations pass independent review.
out_of_scope: Personal identifiers, household locations, raw customer receipts, payment details or restricted records.
Official CPI item indices as price observations, wholesale proxies, inferred historical prices and web retrieval dates used as observation dates.
Calling the pilot a 2024-base replication without separately verified 2024 observations and an unbroken independently anchored series.
